SANTA CLARA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Dec. 20, 2023-- SoundHound AI, Inc. (Nasdaq: SOUN), a global leader in voice artificial intelligence, participated in the following investor events in December and is making the replays available:


- Keyvan Mohajer, CEO and Co-Founder of SoundHound, participated at the Northland Capital Markets Virtual Communications CSaaS Conference on December 1. You can view it[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.soundhound.com%2Fevents%2Fevent-details%2Fnorthland-capital-markets-virtual-communications-csaas-conference&esheet=53873759&newsitemid=20231220164345&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=1&md5=af2036fb387d218757a0f3d1cc7966aa) .
- Keyvan Mohajer, CEO and Co-Founder of SoundHound and Nitesh Sharan, CFO of SoundHound participated at the 2023 Wedbush Software Virtual Bus Tour on December 13. You can view it[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.soundhound.com%2Fevents%2Fevent-details%2F2023-wedbush-software-virtual-bus-tour&esheet=53873759&newsitemid=20231220164345&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=2&md5=81b7c8c0f237aec8c642276d70e8c2cd) .
- Nitesh Sharan, CFO of SoundHound, participated at the Northland Capital Markets Virtual AI Conference: Object and Language Understanding on December 14. You can view it[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.soundhound.com%2Fevents%2Fevent-details%2Fnorthland-capital-markets-virtual-ai-conference-object-and-language&esheet=53873759&newsitemid=20231220164345&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=3&md5=b8ac5115c84d0196daad638efeeba69f) .


If you wish to receive company email notifications, please register at[investor.soundhound.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.soundhound.com%2Fir-resources%2Femail-alerts&esheet=53873759&newsitemid=20231220164345&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.soundhound.com&index=4&md5=5a076888e3414b34d92b78157125be04) .


**About SoundHound AI**


SoundHound (Nasdaq: SOUN), a global leader in conversational intelligence, offers voice AI solutions that let businesses offer incredible conversational experiences to their customers. Built on proprietary technology, SoundHound’s voice AI delivers best-in-class speed and accuracy in numerous languages to product creators across automotive, TV, and IoT, and to customer service industries via groundbreaking AI-driven products like Smart Answering, Smart Ordering, and Dynamic Interaction™, a real-time, multimodal customer service interface. Along with SoundHound Chat AI, a powerful voice assistant with integrated Generative AI, SoundHound powers millions of products and services, and processes billions of interactions each year for world class businesses.[www.soundhound.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.soundhound.com&esheet=53873759&newsitemid=20231220164345&lan=en-US&anchor=www.soundhound.com&index=5&md5=eb07a0d7100175e483f51b91221e4fec) .
